page.overview:
Who is Tygurah?

Tygurah is an Adventurers Orient Expedition Big Figure introduced in 2003. It is exclusive to the set 7411 Tygurah's Roar.

Tygurah uses the same build as the Yeti and Jun-Chi and consists of eight light orange brown pieces. Legs and arms are attached to a body assembled from two Technic Brick 1X2, Ø4.9 and one Plate 2X2. This is covered by a single large piece (unique to Tygurah) that comprises his torso and the tiger-shaped head; this piece is printed with white fur, black tiger stripes, and a black nose on the head. A light orange brown tail is attached to his back, which gives Tygurah one more piece than either the Yeti or Jun-Chi.

The Tygurah is a large Indian creature that resembles a humanoid tiger. He guards the Sunstone at an altar that has a bridge spanning a large chasm. According to Babloo in 4215473 Die Suche nach dem Goldenen Drachen, Tygurah acts in service to the gods by protecting the Sunstone, which brings good weather and harvest, and one knows that Tygurah is near when his roar can be heard.

After Maharaja Lallu demands that Babloo bring him the Sunstone, the Adventurers volunteer to help Babloo. Dr. Kilroy discovers the altar and encounters Tygurah, who gives chase. In the comics, the bridge breaks when Tygurah stands on it and he falls through, prompting Kilroy to remark that the "Tygurah needs a diet"; Episode 02 shows Tygurah disappearing into the chasm below, while the 7411 comic merely shows Tygurah becoming dazed. The audio drama does not show Tygurah's defeat at all, and Kilroy hears his roar throughout the night.
